cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between messages for the same failing table, source or destination. 0 sends every time.

enabled.description: Whether the alert runs. Defaults to true.

grouping.description: How the alert splits into groups, each of which fires and resolves on its own. Replaces the stored grouping as a whole.

keys.description: One key that matches the alert. source_id for source_kind=warehouse_source with group_by=source (the default), schema_id for group_by=schema, destination_id for source_kind=warehouse_destination.

name.description: Name of the alert, such as "Stripe sync failures".

source_config.description: What to watch. Send {} to watch every source (or destination) in the project.

destination_ids.description: For source_kind=warehouse_destination: IDs of the destinations to watch, from external-data-destinations-list. Empty or omitted watches every destination in the project, including destinations added later.

email_project_members.description: Also email the project members who get data pipeline error emails when the alert fires or resolves. Defaults to false.

group_by.description: For source_kind=warehouse_source. source (default) keeps one alert group, and sends one message, per failing source. schema does the same per failing table. It must match grouping.keys: source_id for source, schema_id for schema.

include_billing_limits.description: For source_kind=warehouse_source. Also fire when a table stops syncing at the project's billing limit. Defaults to false.

source_ids.description: For source_kind=warehouse_source: IDs of the sources to watch, from external-data-sources-list. Empty or omitted watches every source in the project, including sources added later.

source_kind.description: What the alert watches. warehouse_source alerts when a source or one of its tables fails to sync. warehouse_destination alerts when a destination that sources sync to fails or is paused.
